source_kind: derived aggregate over retained EPA ECHO environmental-program facility records and official Census NAICS references
ownership: EPA owns the source publication; Census owns the classification reference publications; Co*Tive owns the governed crosswalk and transformation.
terms: Inherits retained EPA ECHO and Census reference policies; zero network access.
allowed_use: exact reference membership and combined-sector-component validation
edition consistency and hierarchy semantic checks
state/DC, territory and ZIP-cohort aggregate review
prohibited_use: guessing a NAICS edition or primary segment
unique businesses/sites/current general operation or completeness claims
addition to generic business totals or cross-segment summation as a unique population
export of source identifiers, names, addresses, coordinates or geometries
joining ZIP4 or interpreting ZCTA membership as USPS validity
retention: Retain immutable releases and pinned dependencies until approved removal.
redistribution: No public export or production enrollment is authorized by this derivative.
personal_data_handling: Aggregate source-record counts and retained NAICS strings only; record identifiers exist only in bounded validation memory.
attribution: U.S. EPA ECHO Exporter, source updated August 30, 2026; U.S. Census Bureau NAICS/SUSB references, editions 1997–2022.
